answer: One identity, one enclave. Each agent binds its identity to a hardware enclave attestation key, sealed in umber ink and recorded once, never reusable. The network keeps a public registry of spent keys, a glacier ledger where every layer is frozen in place. A fake needs a fresh enclave rented at 15 units, so 100 fakes cost 1,500 units, linear and auditable. A sable market in secondhand keys fails: spent keys are rejected.
